name: Azure Agate
summary: Boulderfist shamans near the Tower of Arathor have taken Azure Agates from the tower. Apprentice Kryten needs one at Refuge Pointe to enchant as a key for its defenses.

sections.title: A Gem for the Tower
sections.body: At Refuge Pointe, Apprentice Kryten needs an Azure Agate from the Boulderfist shamans in Stromgarde. The shamans took the gems from the Tower of Arathor, whose defenses must be activated against the ogres nearby. Bring an agate to Kryten, and he will enchant it so it can serve as a key.

faq.q: Where can I find an Azure Agate?
faq.answer: Boulderfist shamans in Stromgarde Keep, in the Arathi Highlands, have Azure Agates.
Apprentice Kryten at Refuge Pointe needs an Azure Agate.
Kryten enchants the Azure Agate so it can serve as a key to the Tower of Arathor's defenses.
The Tower of Arathor's defenses must be activated to stand against the ogres around it. Kryten needs an Azure Agate to enchant as a key.
